medications.name: Paracetamol

advice.text: Ensure oral fluid intake of about 2400 ml per 24 h (or 2 ml/kg/h since weight <50 kg) using water, ORS, coconut water, fruit juices or soup.

Return to the hospital immediately if any warning sign develops: clinical deterioration with settling fever, inability to tolerate oral fluids, severe abdominal pain, lethargy or irritability, bleeding tendency, reduced urine output, cold clammy extremities, or difficulty breathing.
Re‑evaluate in 24–48 hours or sooner if symptoms worsen.
